title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1+2+POST PARKIMI TEK METROPOLITAN RESIDENCE NE KAMEZ! (SIMA COM)

-Dy tualete (nje prej te cileve me ndricim dhe ajrosje natyrale)

title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+2+PARKING SPACE AT METROPOLITAN RESIDENCE IN KAMEZ! (SIMA COM)
description_en: -The apartment is located on the edge of the main road on Blue Boulevard in Kamez, in one of the newest and best complexes in the area and is organized as follows: -Corridor, which divides the other rooms -The common living room with the kitchen area -Three bedrooms (one of which has a toilet with natural lighting and ventilation) -Two toilets (one of which has natural lighting and ventilation) -Orientation East - The parking post included in the price - The construction is in the final stage
